title: Choose the portfolio's visual world
question: Each direction keeps the site quiet and writing-first, but gives the learning archive a different identity.

options.label: The Night Reading Room
options.lineage: library card catalogues and after-hours reading rooms
options.thesis: Each write-up becomes a dated catalogue card that opens into a calm study sheet.
options.viewport: A compact identity column sits beside one featured reading card and the beginning of a chronological writing index.
options.risk: It becomes nostalgic or gimmicky if drawers, stamps, and library props are used literally.

raised.raise: The writing index keeps one uninterrupted chronological rhythm with a single active marker.
Every new post visibly extends the same cumulative body of work instead of becoming an isolated card.
Dates and learning stages remain immediately legible without turning progress into a score.
Large empty fields and a few confident blocks prevent the archival idea from becoming busy.

options.label: The Process Folio
options.lineage: architecture-school process portfolios and pinned critique sheets
options.thesis: The site reads as a curated sequence of working sheets where progress matters more than finished polish.
options.viewport: One oversized current sheet leads while a narrow folio index reveals earlier studies underneath.
options.risk: This is the most familiar scholarship-portfolio direction and can feel like design school rather than security research.

options.label: The Exposure Record
options.lineage: darkroom exposure sheets and eleven-step zone records
options.thesis: Each post separates what was observed, what remains uncertain, and what changed after another pass.
options.viewport: A bright study sheet overlaps a tonal learning scale, with the newest post occupying the clearest exposure zone.
options.case: It communicates careful method and uncertainty unusually well, but the darkroom metaphor is less immediately readable than the catalogue.
options.risk: Layering can recreate the visual density that the previous redesign removed.

options.label: The Rhythm Machine
options.thesis: Posts appear as steps in a learning sequence rather than finished achievements.
options.viewport: A sixteen-step timeline places each post in one continuous sequence.
options.case: The progress metaphor is strong, but it reads as a music tool before it reads as a writing portfolio.
options.kept: One uninterrupted chronology and one precise active-state cue.
options.risk: It would feel like a novelty interface and distract from reading.

options.label: The Maturation Calendar
options.lineage: seasonal pickling logs and dated batch labels
options.thesis: Learning is shown as work that develops over time rather than arriving complete.
options.viewport: Recent notes appear as dated batches with a short statement of what changed.
options.case: The growth idea is honest, but the culinary world weakens technical credibility for this audience.
options.kept: Dates and stages should make learning progress understandable at a glance.
options.risk: The metaphor can feel cute rather than credible.

options.label: The Coiled Record
options.thesis: Every write-up adds another visible course to an unfinished structure.
options.viewport: A vertical chronology grows course by course beside a concise introduction.
options.case: It expresses cumulative effort, but its physical metaphor obscures the fact that this is a writing portfolio.
options.kept: Posts must feel cumulative, forming one visible body of work.
options.risk: The sculptural treatment could overpower sparse content.

options.label: The Learning Metropolis
options.thesis: Every post becomes a discoverable place in an expanding field of interests.
options.viewport: A compact pixel landscape maps the current learning areas and opens individual posts.
options.case: It is memorable, but it misrepresents a writing-first portfolio and requires artwork the author does not have.
options.kept: Closer reading should reveal small details grounded in the actual posts.
options.risk: It can look game-like and juvenile in an application context.

options.label: The Geometric Portrait
options.thesis: A few changing planes represent the interests that gradually form the author's profile.
options.viewport: A responsive abstract portrait shares the first viewport with a short introduction and latest post.
options.case: The composition is distinctive, but it emphasizes a visual identity the author has not established over the writing itself.
options.kept: Use fewer, larger elements and let empty space do structural work.
options.risk: It can make the portfolio feel like a graphic-design showcase.

canonCard.label: The familiar technical blog
canonCard.thesis: A dark monospace introduction followed by a conventional chronological post list.
canonCard.viewport: A compact greeting sits above the latest posts in the arrangement visitors already expect.
canonCard.risk: It remains close to the original reference and gives visitors little to remember.
